tentur: Enunciatio verò tota sermonem resipit
hominum verè sanctorum, qui iustificati fide

in suis oppressionibus & angustiis gloriantur,

ctæ illæ animæ spiritu Dei actæ, id non esse sua-

contrà quàm pietas & charitas Christiana do-
cet, proterue in lapsum impellerentgnon[?] ut mi-
seros etiam non intelligentes, vel ad se non ad-
vertentes animum, persequerentur infesti: sed
hoc sibi potiùs curandum esse, ut ad suos pedes,
id est, institutum vitæ & administrationis suæ
attenderent, eos circummunirent à rebus om-
nibus adversis, & se in omni bono secundum
Deum & coram ipso in Ecclesia confirmarent.
Quem finem si actuosum hoc nostrū seculum
ante oculos iamdiu proposuisset sibi, certè tot
funestis malis iamdiu caruisset mundus, & fe-
liciter Ecclesia increscens ægrè fecisset Satanæ
& sceleratissimis administris eius. De perseve-
rantia diximus; iam de altero illo quem propo-
suimus loco, de finibus, inquam, & terminis
ad perseverantiam constitutis videamus.

page.notes: Running head "EIRENICT" is uncertain at its last letter. "impellerentgnon" appears to be a printing error (a semicolon or colon may be intended); copied as printed. The catchword "tia" is the start of the next page's word "perseverantia". No marginal notes are printed on this page; the dark edges on the left and right are from the neighbouring pages and were left out. Long s is transcribed as s throughout, so words such as "perseverantia" are read as printed with long s.
